parameters.description:
`msg-to-messagebird-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your MessageBird destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own MessageBird destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional MessageBird destinations bound per enrollment.

Create a MessageBird account at messagebird.com, then copy your API key from the MessageBird dashboard and set it as MESSAGEBIRD_SMS_APIKEY. Set MESSAGEBIRD_SMS_FROM to the phone number you registered with MessageBird (including its country code), and MESSAGEBIRD_SMS_TO to the destination phone number, e.g. +14155551234.

((_body.title and _body.title ~= "" and _body.body and _body.body ~= "") and ": " or "") .. (_body.body or "")) *}}
